belongs_to_collection.name: After Hours at the Arcade Collection

data.overview: A year after a deadly night at a family arcade, the town has turned its rumors into a kitschy festival. When a child slips back inside to see the mascots she remembers, buried secrets wake with them—and the celebration becomes another locked-room nightmare.
data.tagline: Some legends are better left asleep.
data.title: After Hours at the Arcade
